SPY.text: SPY rose about 1.4% as hopes for renewed U.S.-Iran talks drove oil roughly 5% lower and pulled Treasury yields down, easing inflation concerns; strong earnings and technology gains broadened the rally.

QQQ.text: QQQ gained about 1.8%, led by mega-cap technology including Amazon, Meta and Alphabet, as falling oil and Treasury yields improved risk appetite on hopes for renewed U.S.-Iran talks.
